data.one_liner: Convert font characters and icons into paths and animate them in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Parses TTF font assets in pure Dart to convert characters and icons into Flutter Path objects or SVG path strings. It provides utilities to transform, break paths into pieces, and animate the rendering process on a Canvas.
use_when: You want to create text-drawing or character-morphing animations in Flutter.
You need to generate SVG path strings or Flutter Path objects directly from TrueType (.ttf) font files.
avoid_when: You need support for font formats other than .ttf.
You need a package guaranteed to handle every edge case of complex custom fonts without bugs.
strengths: Pure Flutter and Dart implementation with a built-in TTF font parser.
Includes utilities for breaking paths into pieces for sequential drawing animations.
weaknesses: Still a work in progress with no guarantee of handling every single font.
